transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I don’t get any enjoyment out of the things I used to love doing, and I can’t make myself start anything anymore. My sister got really worried about how unlike myself I’ve been acting lately and urged me to come in.
Have you ever experienced periods of time, lasting at least a few days, where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or requiring much less sleep than usual?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. It's actually been the complete opposite for me—I just feel constantly drained of energy and wiped out lately.
Have you recently experienced hearing voices or seeing things that other people cannot hear or see, or felt like others are watching or plotting against you?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I don't hear or see things that aren't there, and I certainly don't feel like anyone is watching me or plotting against me.
How long have you been experiencing this lack of enjoyment and low energy? Has it been going on nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yes, it's been going on nearly every day for about a month now. This heavy, joyless feeling really took hold of me right after a promising consulting contract fell through at the very final stage.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns or appetite since this started about a month ago?

Yes, both have been really off. I lie awake until two or three in the morning with my mind looping over worries about work and money, waking up multiple times and never feeling rested. I've also lost my appetite, often realizing late in the afternoon that I've only had coffee and toast, and I only eat because I know I should.
Along with the lack of enjoyment and low energy, have you also been feeling persistently sad or down, or have you experienced feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?

Yes, a heavy, down feeling has been hanging over me constantly. I keep blaming myself for losing those consulting contracts and feel like I've let everyone down. I honestly feel like a deadweight to my sister and my ex, and that they'd be better off without me.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of feeling very down, losing interest in things, and struggling with sleep or energy at any other time in your life before this past month?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before in my life. This is the first time I've ever felt this down or completely lost interest in the things I love.
Since you mentioned feeling like others might be better off without you, have you had any actual thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life?

It's hard to admit, but I regularly catch myself thinking it wouldn't be so bad if I just didn't wake up one of these mornings. On a couple of really bad days, I've even found myself picturing how I might end things, though I haven't actually acted on those thoughts.
